_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Data for Munitions (TDM)
summary: Used to obtain the Technical Data for Munitions (TDM) information necessary for the safe and efficient storage, maintenance, inspection, and transportation of ammunition and explosives stored on the Eglin Test Ranges.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) will be used to obtain the Technical Data for Munitions (TDM) information that is necessary for the safe and efficient storage, maintenance, inspection and transportation of ammunitions and explosives to be stored on the Eglin Test Ranges.

a. This DID meets the requirements of Eglin Air Force Base Instruction (EGLINAFBI) 91-206, Munitions Source Data.
(Copies of this document are available on line at www.e-publishing.af.mil.)
b. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements for this data included in the contract.
c. This DID is applicable to all research and development munitions requiring storage by military personnel.
d. This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-80182B.

children.content: (Copies of this document are available on line at www.e-publishing.af.mil.)

children.content: (Copies of this TO are available from www.my.af.mil/ammoprod/wm.)

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TDM shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following:

children.title: General
children.content: General appearance of the item, including type (fuze, warhead, bomb, etc.), part number, nomenclature, serial numbers, and information for visual identification of the item.

children.title: Physical and Operational Description
children.content: Size, diameter, thickness, energetic composition, etc.

children.title: Operational Description
children.content: How the item attaches, assembles, and otherwise works with the end item.

children.title: Detailed Description of Explosive Train
children.content: (Include Quantity and Type of each Explosive Component. Include all types energetic materials used in the item, e.g. lithium based thermal batteries/igniters, compressed gasses, etc.)

children.title: Net Explosives Weight Per Item
children.content: (Include total quantity and type of explosives.)

children.title: Drawings and Schematics
children.content: (if available).

children.title: Technical Data
children.content: List all of the following subitems. Write each topic as listed after each subletter and parenthetical number.

children.title: Inspection Procedures
children.content: NOTE: The above apply to both the item and its container.

children.title: List defects which render the item unsafe
children.content: Describe each defect by quantity, dimensions, location, or percent of area coverage which is most applicable to the defect being described.

children.title: List defects which render the item unserviceable
children.content: Describe each defect by quantity, dimensions, locations, or percent of area coverage which is most applicable to the defect being described.

children.title: List defects for which the item is still safe and serviceable
children.content: Describe each defect by quantity, dimensions, location, or percent of area coverage, whichever is most applicable to the defect being described.

children.title: List corrective actions necessary to return an item from unserviceable to serviceable for each defect noted
children.content: For any parts replacement, include Part Number and quantity of items to be replaced.

children.title: List inspection time interval and percentage sample size for items to be maintained in storage.
Container requirements (reusability, humidification and stack height).
Shelf and service life are defined as follows:
Shelf Life
children.content: Length of time an item can remain in storage under prescribed packaging and storage conditions. Expiration date for shelf life on items with month and year listed is last day of month. The starting point for shelf life determination is the date of production of the item.

children.title: Service life
children.content: Length of time an item can remain installed in operating configuration or in actual usage. Expiration date for service life will be the last day of expiration month regardless of actual expiration date. Service life will not exceed shelf life of an item.

children.title: Requirement for inside or outside storage.
National Stock Numbers (NSNs)
children.content: For items covered under National Stock Numbers (NSNs), include the shelf and service life established by the developing contractor based on test and historical data.

children.title: R&D items
children.content: For R&D items which have no Federal Stock, include the shelf and service life established by the developing contractor based on test and historical data.

children.title: Handling procedures (include fragile areas to avoid).
Tiedown instructions (reference TO 11-1-38 for like items).
Drop height from which items may be unserviceable
children.content: Requires specific footage. When item has been dropped and exceeds this distance, indicate disposition.

children.title: List of armed or hazardous conditions indications.
Emergency Procedures
children.content: List any precautions and procedures to be used until Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) or fire-fighting personnel arrive. (If none or not applicable, so state.)

children.title: Demilitarization Code
children.content: Make one of the following statements: "Demilitarization Code G" (If item contains explosives.) "Demilitarization Code B" (If item is inert.)

children.title: Security Classification
children.content: Classified and sensitive items shall be accompanied by a statement of required safeguards and necessary storage requirements. Controlled Inventory Item Code (CIIC) must be included. The TDM must include proper distribution statements and marking classifications.

children.title: Unit Cost
children.content: Actual or estimated unit cost.
